sloka: अथोत्थाय जलं स्पृष्ट्वा भरतो वाक्यमब्रवीत् ।श्रृण्वन्तु मे परिषदो मन्त्रिण: श्रेणयस्तथा ॥ २.१११.२४॥
transliteration: athotthāya jalaṁ spṛṣṭvā bharato vākyamabravīt ।śrṛṇvantu me pariṣado mantriṇa: śreṇayastathā ॥ 2.111.24॥

translations.english: Then Bharata stood up and performed achamana (sipping of water) and said 'let the assembly of learned men, counsellors and guildsmen hear me'.
